from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((r, c))
            queue = deque([(r, c)])
            cells = []
            while queue:
                x, y = queue.popleft()
                cells.append((x, y))
                for dx, dy in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (x + dx, y + dy)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < rows and 0 <= p[1] < cols
                            and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        queue.append(p)
            min_r = min(x for x, _ in cells)
            min_c = min(y for _, y in cells)
            shape = frozenset((x - min_r, y - min_c) for x, y in cells)
            components.append((color, cells, shape))

    colors_by_shape = {}
    for color, cells, shape in components:
        if color != 1:
            colors_by_shape.setdefault(shape, color)
    for color, cells, shape in components:
        if color == 1 and shape in colors_by_shape:
            replacement = colors_by_shape[shape]
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = replacement
    return out
'''
